product_metadata.title: Signature Design by Ashley Willowton Coastal Entertainment Center Pier Bookcase with 3 Adjustable Shelves, Whitewash
features: COASTAL CHIC BOOKCASE: This home entertainment pier doubles as a streamlined bookcase and is the ultimate statement piece for your coastal cottage or shabby chic inspired retreat
BEACH-CHIC CHARM: The whitewash finish, paired with the bookcase’s unique plank-style sides, is a look that has our minds drifting away to beachy escapes
PIER-STYLE DESIGN: The tall, pier-style unit with four open shelves allows you to put home accents on display, safely out of the way
STORAGE SOLUTION: Four sturdy open shelves hold your belongings with ease. You are going to love propping up your books in style
ASSEMBLY REQUIRED: Bookcase measures 17.13" W x 11.89" D x 71.97" H; Easy-to-follow instructions and hardware included. Two people recommended
description: This TV pier is the ultimate statement piece for your coastal cottage or shabby chic inspired retreat. Whitewash finish is wonderfully easy on the eyes. It’s a driftwoody look that has our minds drifting away to beachy-keen escapes. Create the shelf space you’ve always wanted with a well-placed storage pier. Each shelf gives you the opportunity to organize your books or DVDs—or even display your favorite decor. And we go the extra mile to package, protect and deliver your purchase in a timely manner. Trust us to bring your space to life with furniture and decor that show off your style and personality.
